content: The treatment of symptomatic heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) has been evaluated in the EMPEROR-Preserved trial, which specifically investigated the effects of empagliflozin in this patient population. The trial demonstrated that empagliflozin significantly reduced the risk of heart failure-related hospitalizations. Additionally, it showed improvements in patients' overall health status, functional capacity, and symptom burden. The findings from this study underscore the therapeutic benefits of empagliflozin as an effective treatment option for individuals with HFpEF. It not only enhances the quality of life for these patients but also decreases their likelihood of requiring hospitalization due to heart failure.
